title: Webhook storm after an outage (with GS.03 late older vendor revision)
story: 1,000 duplicate E-Verify status signals across 100 subjects in 10 s, out of order. Added schedule: a vendor's older revision of a status arrives after a newer one for the same subject.
checked: Exactly-once receipts; no read sees a half-applied command; per-subject order kept. GS.03: the late older revision is acknowledged as superseded, current values do not change, and it is recorded in the journal.
rungNote: At 10k: 20 subjects x 5 revisions, each delivery re-sent 0 to 2 times (about 200 deliveries in 10 s). The year-one 1,000 in 10 s waits for PLAN section 8 order 6.

witnesses.negative: onboarded subjects outside the storm (state stays at the post-setup golden)

domain: a revision older than the applied one is acknowledged as superseded (W0 rule; O-DOMAIN, fails closed until EXP-D01; provisional, flagged for Sam in TARGETS 6.1)
reads: Closed-loop pinned readers over storm, idle and trace subjects; every answer must equal one complete golden state (no half-applied command).

gaps: O-REPLAY has no vendor-revision rule; the superseded routing is decided by the generator as a stand-in for the W0 kernel and is claimed only through O-DOMAIN
